_comment: Plant card from roast 48. Generated by tools/analysis/roast48_plant.py --emit-plant.
model: dBT/dt = a * (1 + kf*(fan-60)) * (Inlet(t - theta) - BT) + loss(t)
loss_poly_note: numpy.polyval order, highest power first; t in seconds since CHARGE
note: DO NOT point merge_inlet_base.py at this card. Only kf is settled here (0.000; forcing the retracted 0.049 costs 1.67x the residual), and it says the plant gain does not depend on the fan over 60-70. a and theta are NOT stationary over this run -- sub-window refits spread a 0.0062-0.0085 and theta 7.8-15.5, as wide as the gap to roast 46 -- and the two-lag estimator fits the same data better with theta ~ 0 and a 10-25 s lag, so the 13.5 s deadtime is at least partly a lag. loss_poly is a sacrificial batch's trajectory, not a roast's. plant_roast46.json remains the authoring source.
